answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers penalties proportional to O(k^2), rather than independent linear fines. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, rapidly exhausting the swarm’s escrow and making recovery uneconomic. Thus lotus, umber, and summit nodes are safest when independently controlled and never sign conflicting statements.
